item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话（英文版）：Anthropic IPO，亚马逊收购Decart，特斯拉FSD V15
item.description:
Hi~~ Good evening, everyone! Today is Sunday, November 22, 2026. Welcome to Goodnight Coffee. I’m your host, An An. Tonight, let’s kick back and talk about the latest, freshest business and tech news—light, fun, and packed with substance—to keep you company for a pleasant evening.

@@@

According to cnBeta, AI startup Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO, raising $93.5 billion and securing another $26 billion from tech giants. Its shares rose 17% on their Thursday debut, giving it a $1.8 trillion market value and a fully diluted market value of $1.6 trillion by the weekend. The listing came during Wall Street tech stocks’ worst week since the early days of the pandemic in 2020: Nvidia plunged 23%, its biggest weekly drop in 18 years, while the Nasdaq fell 10% over five trading days. Investors are debating whether Anthropic will trade alongside AI hardware stocks or stand on its own as a pure-play AI developer; Friday’s performance showed Wall Street doubts it can match its high valuation. Founded less than six years ago, Anthropic had received $141 billion from investors as of September. In the third quarter, every $1 spent on compute generated $1.72 in revenue, compared with 68 cents a year earlier. At the IPO price, Menlo Ventures and Lightspeed each hold about $25 billion worth of shares. VC-backed IPOs raised $73 billion in 2021, but only $39 billion in the four years since.

@@@

According to Readhub, Amazon is close to a $7.5 billion deal to acquire AI startup Decart. Talks are in the late stages, and the deal could be finalized as early as early next week, though it could still fall apart. Decart’s core software product can improve AI model efficiency and unlock chip compute. The report says the potential acquisition would help AWS compete with Nvidia.

@@@

According to cnBeta, on November 22, Tesla FSD V15 began rolling out to its first users. The new version uses an all-new architecture. Tesla says handling of safety-critical scenarios has improved 25-fold; the end-to-end driving network has been upgraded, with its vision encoder shared with Robotaxi and Optimus and trained on millions of internet videos. Musk said on X that V15’s driving ability has surpassed human intelligence, but that is his own product assessment and has not yet been confirmed by independent third-party testing. Tesla has also not published complete data sufficient to independently verify the 25-fold improvement, and the metric does not mean the actual traffic accident rate has fallen 25-fold. The system has improved recognition of traffic signs, small animals, debris, and potholes, improved avoidance of deep standing water, and optimized speed control in school zones, speed-limit changes, and severe weather. Tesla Reality View generates a real-time view of surrounding roads from a virtual perspective above the vehicle and displays navigation turn prompts in the interface. Musk previously said V15 was planned for a broader rollout in December. The current version still requires continuous driver supervision and readiness to take over at any time.

@@@

According to cnBeta, citing Tom’s Hardware, Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed that Intel 18A process yield has risen to 70%, in line with expectations for the ramp-up phase of a new process. Tan said that when he first took office, Intel 18A yield was quite poor, and it has now improved significantly, but he did not specify whether the 70% refers to functional yield, parametric yield, or the proportion of saleable chips. By common industry understanding, it generally refers to the percentage of dies passing basic electrical and functional tests. Intel has already mass-produced the Core Ultra 300 series, codenamed “Panther Lake,” in the second half of 2025, with its compute module using Intel 18A. A 70% yield is a decent result during ramp-up, but economics also depend on parametric yield and ultimately how many high-premium products can be supplied. The data-center “Clearwater Forest” Xeon 6+ series also uses Intel 18A, with up to 288 cores, combined with Foveros Direct 3D packaging technology. Intel has also just released Intel 14A PDK 0.9, allowing customers to start product development in a design environment close to mass production; the next-generation process node is proceeding on schedule.

@@@

According to cnBeta, European Council President Costa unveiled a revision of the EU’s long-term budget for 2028 to 2034 on November 21. The plan aims to expand EU fiscal revenue by imposing a digital services tax, an e-waste tax, and higher tobacco taxes, in order to ease disputes among member states over budget size and contribution shares. The proposal calls for large tech companies with annual digital business revenue in the EU of at least €50 million and global annual revenue of more than €750 million to pay a 3% digital services tax on annual net operating revenue from online advertising, digital intermediation services, and user-generated data-related businesses. Germany advocates sharply cutting the long-term budget previously proposed by the European Commission and, along with Sweden and five other member states, questions the introduction of new taxes. Swedish Minister for European Affairs Rosenkranz said the EU should focus on cutting spending and reducing member-state contributions. France believes the EU needs sufficient fiscal resources to meet challenges; 17 member states from Southern, Central, and Eastern Europe have formed the “Friends of Cohesion” alliance, advocating more funding for agriculture and regional development. EU leaders will meet in Brussels next week to discuss the plan. Costa hopes to reach an agreement in December and avoid negotiations dragging into 2027. France and several other member states will hold elections in 2027, and if Eurosceptic parties win, negotiations could become even harder.

@@@

According to Readhub, Alibaba disclosed in its second-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings report that revenue from AI cloud and compute services reached RMB 60.973 billion during the period, up 53% year on year. The new-generation training-and-inference integrated AI chip Zhenwu V900, built by T-Head, will enter mass production and sales in the first quarter of 2027. Its compute is three times that of the previous-generation Zhenwu M890, it comes with 216GB of memory, and it has inter-chip interconnect bandwidth of 1,200GB/s. It natively supports FP8 and FP4 low-precision computing, can cover large-model training and inference tasks, and is suited to high-load scenarios. With its in-house solution, the chip can achieve thousand-card full-bandwidth high-speed interconnection. The new-generation Alibaba Cloud AI super node equipped with it can scale up to 500,000 cards per cluster, with full-stack collaboration reducing communication loss. Zhenwu M890 has already achieved large-scale commercial use. With V900 deliveries, Alibaba Cloud’s self-developed compute supply capability will improve further; T-Head also plans to launch the next-generation Zhenwu J900 chip in 2028.

@@@

According to cnBeta, XPeng AeroHT announced that its full-scale, full-tilt electric flying car A868 successfully completed a tilt-transition test flight, making it the first Chinese company to complete tilt-transition flight with a full-scale prototype. Tilt transition means the complete transition from vertical takeoff and landing to high-speed level flight. After A868 completed its first takeoff-and-landing test flight in November 2025, it entered the full-tilt flight phase in just one year. The aircraft debuted on November 5, 2025, using a six-rotor full-tilt fixed-wing layout. It is equipped with the Kunpeng super range-extender architecture and a self-developed aviation-grade hybrid-electric core, with a designed range of more than 500 kilometers, a maximum speed of more than 360 kilometers per hour, and six seats in a 2+2+2 layout. The full-tilt configuration has no redundant dead weight in level flight and offers optimal aerodynamic efficiency, but coupled control of the tilt mechanisms and flight control is the hardest part. US company Joby Aviation has completed tilt-transition verification, while Overair and others have not. The report says this marks Chinese companies entering the global first tier. A868 targets multi-passenger, medium-to-long-distance, high-efficiency business travel, and together with the “Land Aircraft Carrier,” forms two major product directions.

@@@

According to Huxiu 24 Hours, Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi said AI has already reached many parts of clinical care, and he believes AI can become a reliable link connecting doctors and patients and extending care.

@@@

According to Readhub, Tencent Chief AI Scientist and Hunyuan large-model lead Yao Shunyu and researchers from the Hunyuan team held an AMA on Reddit. It was the first time the Hunyuan team publicly took questions in a developer community. The two-hour Q&A session received more than 300 comments, covering the model’s technical roadmap, architecture trade-offs, future plans, and safety evaluations. The team revealed that a smaller Hy4-mini is already on the roadmap and said it will consider developing smaller image models, while video models are also worth watching. Asked why ByteDance, Kimi, and other companies are pushing ultra-large models with 3T or even 5T parameters while Hunyuan remains at 700B, the team responded that Hy3 and Hy4 have shown that a well-built smaller model can often outperform larger models, and more importantly, it costs less and allows the team to learn and gain more in the process.

@@@

According to QbitAI, US AI music platform Suno announced the launch of its visual creation tool Visuals, bringing video and image generation into the music creation process. Suno disclosed that Visuals’ model H3 Move is built on the open-source video model H3 from Chinese AI company MiniMax and has been tuned for music scenarios; Suno said the team optimized the model with its own data for music video production. Videos generated by Visuals can echo the song’s structure and lyrics and support singing lip-sync. Users can combine music and text prompts to generate clips of up to 15 seconds, then extend, arrange, and edit them on a timeline; they can also make lyric videos and album covers. MiniMax H3 was released with open weights in August this year and supports up to 2K resolution and 15-second duration. Visuals uses a separate paid credit system: video and image generation consume Visual credits and are billed separately from song-generation credits. The platform has also added text and visual filtering and embeds a watermark before external sharing. Suno says more than 100 million people have used its platform to create music.

@@@

Alright, that’s all for today’s show! Thank you for spending time with us. May you go to sleep in a good mood. If you like our show, you’re very welcome to subscribe and share it with your friends—it helps us a lot. See you next time!

item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话：Anthropic IPO，亚马逊收购Decart，特斯拉FSD V15
item.description:
嗨~~大家晚上好呀！今天是2026年11月22日，星期日，欢迎收听晚安咖啡，我是主播安安。今晚咱们一起聊聊新鲜热乎的商业科技动态，轻松又有料，陪你度过一段愉快的晚间时光～

@@@

据cnBeta消息，AI初创公司Anthropic完成创纪录IPO，融资935亿美元，另从科技巨头处获260亿美元；周四首秀涨17%，市值1.8万亿美元，周末完全稀释市值1.6万亿美元。此次上市正值华尔街科技股自2020年疫情初期以来最糟一周：英伟达暴跌23%创18年最大周跌幅，纳指五个交易日跌10%。投资者争论其会随AI硬件股交易，还是作为纯粹AI开发商独立存在；周五表现显示华尔街怀疑其能否匹配高估值。成立不到六年的Anthropic截至9月已获投资者投入1410亿美元；第三季度每花1美元算力产生1.72美元收入，一年前为68美分。按IPO价，Menlo Ventures和Lightspeed各持约250亿美元股票；2021年风投支持的IPO收益730亿美元，之后四年仅390亿美元。

@@@

据Readhub消息，亚马逊即将达成一项以75亿美元收购AI初创公司Decart的交易，双方谈判已进入后期阶段，交易最早可能于下周初敲定，但仍存在谈判破裂的可能。Decart的核心软件产品可提升AI模型运行效率、释放芯片算力。报道称，这笔潜在收购将助力亚马逊云科技与英伟达展开竞争。

@@@

cnBeta消息，11月22日，特斯拉FSD V15开始向首批用户推送。新版本采用全新架构。特斯拉称，安全关键场景处理能力提升25倍；端到端驾驶网络升级，视觉编码器与Robotaxi、Optimus共享，并经数百万条互联网视频训练。马斯克在X上称，V15驾驶能力已超越人类智能，但这属于其对产品的评价，尚缺独立第三方测试证实；特斯拉也未公布足以独立验证25倍提升的完整数据，该指标不意味着实际交通事故率降低25倍。系统增强了对交通标志、小动物、散落物和坑洼的识别，改善深积水规避，并优化学校区域、限速变化和恶劣天气下的车速控制。Tesla Reality View以车辆上方虚拟视角实时生成周边道路画面，并将导航转向提示显示在界面中。马斯克此前称，V15计划12月向更广泛用户推送。当前版本仍需驾驶员持续监督，并须随时准备接管。

@@@

cnBeta援引TomsHardware报道，英特尔首席执行官陈立武确认，Intel 18A制程良品率已提升至70%，符合全新制程爬坡阶段的预期。陈立武表示，他刚上任时Intel 18A良品率相当糟糕，如今已有很大改善，但他没有说明70%指的是功能良品率、参数良品率还是可售芯片占比；按业界通常理解，一般默认指通过基本电气与功能测试的裸片百分比。英特尔已在2025年下半年量产代号“Panther Lake”的酷睿Ultra 300系列，其计算模块采用Intel 18A。70%的良品率在爬坡阶段算是不错结果，但经济性还取决于参数良品率及最终能供应多少高溢价产品。面向数据中心的“Clearwater Forest”至强6+系列也采用Intel 18A，最多拥有288核心，并结合Foveros Direct 3D封装技术。英特尔还刚发布Intel 14A PDK 0.9，让客户可在接近量产的设计环境中启动产品开发；下一代制程节点正按计划进行。

@@@

cnBeta消息，欧洲理事会主席科斯塔11月21日公布欧盟2028年至2034年长期预算修订方案，拟通过征收数字服务税、电子废弃物税和提高烟草税扩大欧盟财政收入，以缓解成员国围绕预算规模及出资比例的争议。方案提出，对在欧盟境内年度数字业务营收达到5000万欧元、且全球年度营收超过7.5亿欧元的大型科技企业，按在线广告、数字中介服务及用户生成数据相关业务年度净营业收入的3%征收数字服务税。德国主张大幅削减欧盟委员会此前提出的长期预算，并与瑞典等另外五个成员国质疑开征新税；瑞典欧洲事务大臣罗森克兰茨称，欧盟应重点削减支出并减少成员国出资。法国认为欧盟需要充足财政资源应对挑战，来自南欧、中欧及东欧的17个成员国组成“凝聚政策之友”联盟，主张增加农业及区域发展资金。欧盟领导人下周将在布鲁塞尔开会讨论该方案，科斯塔希望12月达成协议，避免谈判拖延至2027年；法国等多个成员国2027年将举行选举，疑欧派政党若胜选可能加大谈判难度。

@@@

据Readhub报道，阿里巴巴在2027财年第二季度财报中披露，期内AI云与算力服务收入达609.73亿元，同比增长53%。平头哥打造的新一代训推一体AI芯片真武V900将于2027年一季度量产售卖，算力为上一代真武M890的三倍，配备216GB显存，片间互联带宽1200GB/s，原生支持FP8、FP4低精度计算，可覆盖大模型训练与推理任务，适配高负载场景。依托自研方案，该芯片可实现千卡全带宽高速互联，搭载它的新一代阿里云AI超节点单集群最高可扩展至50万卡规模，全栈协同降低通信损耗。此前真武M890已实现规模化商用。随着V900交付，阿里云自研算力供给能力将进一步提升；平头哥还规划2028年推出真武系列下一代J900芯片。

@@@

cnBeta消息，小鹏汇天宣布，全尺寸全倾转电动飞行汽车A868倾转过渡试飞成功，成为中国首家完成全尺寸样机倾转过渡飞行的企业。倾转过渡即从垂直起降完整转为高速平飞；A868自2025年11月完成首次起降试飞后，仅一年便进入全倾转飞行阶段。该机于2025年11月5日首发，采用六旋翼全倾转固定翼布局，搭载鲲鹏超级增程架构与自研航空级混电内核，设计续航超500公里、最大航速超360公里/小时，2+2+2六座。全倾转构型平飞无冗余死重、气动效率最优，但倾转机构与飞控耦合控制最难。美国Joby Aviation已完成倾转过渡验证，Overair等尚未完成；报道称，这标志中国企业进入全球第一梯队。A868面向多人、中长途、高效率商务出行，与“陆地航母”构成两大产品方向。

@@@

据虎嗅24小时消息，蚂蚁集团CEO韩歆毅表示，AI已经走到临床的很多环节，他相信AI可以成为连接医患、延续照顾的可靠纽带。

@@@

据Readhub报道，腾讯首席AI科学家、混元大模型负责人姚顺雨和混元团队研究员在Reddit进行了一场AMA，这是混元团队首次在开发者社区公开答问。两小时集中问答收到300多条留言，涉及模型技术路线、架构取舍、未来规划和安全评测等。团队透露，更小尺寸的Hy4-mini已列入路线图，并表示会考虑开发更小的图像模型，视频模型也值得关注。对于字节跳动和Kimi等公司推进参数量达3T甚至5T的超大规模模型、而混元仍在700B的问题，团队回应称，Hy3和Hy4已经表明，做得扎实的较小模型往往可以胜过更大的模型，更重要的是成本更低，也能在过程中学到更多、收获更多。

@@@

量子位消息，美国AI音乐平台Suno宣布推出视觉创作工具Visuals，将视频和图像生成引入音乐创作流程。Suno披露，Visuals采用的模型H3 Move基于中国AI公司MiniMax的开源视频模型H3打造，并针对音乐场景调优；Suno称团队用自有数据针对音乐视频制作优化了该模型。Visuals生成的视频可呼应歌曲结构和歌词，支持演唱口型同步；用户结合音乐和文字提示可生成最长15秒片段，再通过时间轴延长、编排和编辑，也可制作歌词视频和专辑封面。MiniMax H3今年8月开放权重，最高支持2K分辨率和15秒时长。Visuals采用独立付费积分体系，视频和图片生成消耗Visual credits，与歌曲生成积分分开计费；平台还加入文本与视觉过滤，并在对外分享前嵌入水印。Suno称已有超过1亿人使用其平台创作音乐。

@@@

item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话：Anthropic IPO遇冷，英伟达遭SEC调查，DeepSeek融资超1500亿
item.description:
嗨~~大家晚上好呀！今天是2026年11月21日，星期六。我是晚安咖啡的主播安安，欢迎来到今天的节目！今天咱们一起聊聊新鲜热乎的商业科技动态，干货满满、惊喜不断，快搬好小板凳，跟我出发吧～

@@@

新浪科技消息，AI初创企业Anthropic启动估值1.3万亿美元的史上最大IPO，但上市遇冷。其开盘较发行价涨34%，随后涨幅几乎回吐，首日收盘虽上涨但远低于盘中高点；周五该股跌8.5%，勉强守住发行价。周五AI板块遭猛烈抛售，“华丽七巨头”全线走弱，新型云厂商和芯片股两位数下跌，纳指跌5.3%，英伟达跌14%。全周标普500跌8.6%进入回调，纳指跌10%创2020年3月以来最差单周，道指跌8%，Cboe波动率指数升至年内新高；仅本周纳指成分股市值蒸发超4万亿美元。英伟达周二财报超预期，但投资者未获得CEO黄仁勋下台丑闻后续影响的清晰答案，股价继续下挫。市场还担忧数据中心遭抵制、云企业债务高企、科技巨头现金消耗及中期选举后反AI情绪。联博基金经理吉姆·鲁索称，今夏已减持半导体等AI基建标的，因AI实验室盈利前景不明、融资成本走高及数据中心建设难。美联储9月已三年来首次加息，通胀仍高于2%目标。

@@@

据Readhub报道，美国证券交易委员会正在调查英伟达的会计处理方式。知情人士透露了这一消息。该调查使本就深陷丑闻的英伟达面临的法律困境进一步加剧。报道称，目前暂无法确定调查的启动时间，也不清楚监管机构具体审查的潜在会计问题范畴。调查本身并不等同于认定存在不当行为，不少同类调查最终都不会采取执法行动。

@@@

cnBeta消息，美国总统特朗普11月20日在白宫新闻发布会上表示，将阻止美国科技企业在海外建设数据中心，或对相关企业征收“巨额税款”。他称，中国可能利用这些海外设施获取计算资源，因此美国必须阻止；但未公布税率、适用范围和实施时间，也承认尚未与政府相关官员讨论，使这一表态更接近政策设想。Axios指出，美国宪法将联邦税收征收权赋予国会，总统不能单方面创设新税种，若征税需国会立法。报道称，微软、Google、亚马逊、Meta和OpenAI等正投入数千亿美元建设AI数据中心，数据中心选址又关系到网络延迟和当地数据法规，企业难以完全放弃海外布局。此前11月16日，美国商务部发布临时最终规则，把海外数据中心向中国、俄罗斯、伊朗等受限国家和地区企业提供达到规定规模的计算资源、包括远程租用算力，纳入出口许可要求。

@@@

cnBeta消息，Google宣布将于2027年对智能家居生态进行重大调整，逐步淘汰Nest应用，并结束Google Assistant在智能音箱和智能显示屏上的运行，统一转向Gemini for Home平台。Nest应用将于2027年1月25日停止服务，用户需改用Google Home应用管理Nest恒温器、摄像头、门铃、烟雾报警器和智能门锁；现有设备设置和自动化规则将自动迁移，并支持在手机、手表、电视及网页端等多终端访问。Nest硬件继续获得支持，但网页版Nest关闭后，自定义视频片段不会自动转移，用户需提前下载备份，Google将提供一键批量下载。Nest Aware第一代订阅用户将自动迁移至Google Home Premium，无需重新输入支付信息，也不产生额外费用；旧Nest账户数据将从2027年3月25日起开始删除。2027年8月2日，Google Assistant将正式退出智能音箱和智能显示屏，由Gemini for Home取代。新系统可理解更自然的对话，无需记住精确指令，并能回答更复杂的问题。Google此前已在手机平台推动用户转向Gemini，并将在过渡前公布更多功能、兼容性和迁移安排。

cnBeta消息，德国和奥地利11月18日发表联合声明，倡议将TikTok欧洲业务“欧洲化”、由欧洲资本控制，并呼吁其他欧盟成员国加入。德国文化与媒体事务国务部长魏默和奥地利数字化事务国务秘书普勒尔主张改变TikTok欧洲业务所有权结构，并要求控制推荐算法等关键技术设施。其称，TikTok在欧洲约有2亿月活跃用户，德奥约三分之一人口使用，并担心字节跳动作为中国母公司可能依中国法律机制获取欧洲用户数据。此前，爱尔兰数据保护委员会因TikTok向中国传输欧洲用户数据及中国境内人员可访问相关数据，对其罚款5.3亿欧元。德奥计划11月20日在布鲁塞尔欧盟部长会议期间推介该倡议；但欧盟委员会倾向依法监管而非干预资本归属，欧洲也缺乏强制出售机制。美国2024年立法要求出售TikTok美国业务，字节跳动2026年1月同意成立美国投资者控制的合资企业并保留19.9%股份。目前尚无确定收购财团和交易估值，也未启动强制收购。

item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话（英文版）：Anthropic IPO遇冷，英伟达遭SEC调查，DeepSeek融资超1500亿
item.description:
Hi~~ Good evening, everyone! Today is Saturday, November 21, 2026. I’m An’an, your host on Goodnight Coffee, and welcome to today’s show! Today we’re going to talk about the freshest business and tech developments—plenty of substance and plenty of surprises. So grab a seat and let’s get started!

@@@

Sina Tech reports that AI startup Anthropic has launched the largest IPO in history at a valuation of $1.3 trillion, but the listing has received a cold reception. It opened 34% above the issue price, then gave back almost all of those gains; it closed higher on day one but well below its intraday high. On Friday the stock fell 8.5%, barely holding above the issue price. On Friday, the AI sector was hit by heavy selling, with the Magnificent Seven all weakening, new cloud providers and chip stocks dropping by double digits, the Nasdaq falling 5.3%, and Nvidia down 14%. For the week, the S&P 500 fell 8.6% and entered correction territory, the Nasdaq fell 10% for its worst weekly performance since March 2020, the Dow fell 8%, and the Cboe Volatility Index rose to a new high for the year; this week alone, Nasdaq constituent market value evaporated by more than $4 trillion. Nvidia’s earnings on Tuesday beat expectations, but investors did not get a clear answer on the fallout from the scandal surrounding CEO Jensen Huang’s departure, and the stock continued to slide. The market is also worried about resistance to data centers, high debt at cloud companies, cash burn at tech giants, and anti-AI sentiment after the midterm elections. Jim Russo, a fund manager at AllianceBernstein, said he had already reduced holdings in semiconductors and other AI infrastructure targets this summer, citing unclear profit prospects for AI labs, rising financing costs, and difficulties in building data centers. The Fed raised rates in September for the first time in three years, and inflation remains above the 2% target.

@@@

According to Readhub, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Nvidia’s accounting practices. People familiar with the matter disclosed the news. The investigation further adds to the legal troubles facing Nvidia, which is already mired in scandal. The report says it is not yet possible to determine when the investigation began, nor is it clear what potential accounting issues regulators are specifically reviewing. An investigation itself is not equivalent to a finding of wrongdoing, and many similar investigations ultimately do not lead to enforcement action.

@@@

cnBeta reports that Google has announced a major overhaul of its smart home ecosystem in 2027, gradually phasing out the Nest app and ending Google Assistant’s operation on smart speakers and smart displays, shifting everything to the Gemini for Home platform. The Nest app will stop service on January 25, 2027, and users will need to switch to the Google Home app to manage Nest thermostats, cameras, doorbells, smoke alarms, and smart locks; existing device settings and automation rules will migrate automatically, with support for access across phones, watches, TVs, and the web. Nest hardware will continue to be supported, but after the web version of Nest is shut down, custom video clips will not transfer automatically, so users need to download backups in advance, and Google will provide one-click bulk downloads. First-generation Nest Aware subscribers will automatically migrate to Google Home Premium without re-entering payment information and at no extra cost; old Nest account data will begin to be deleted starting March 25, 2027. On August 2, 2027, Google Assistant will officially exit smart speakers and smart displays, replaced by Gemini for Home. The new system can understand more natural conversations, without the need to remember exact commands, and can answer more complex questions. Google has previously pushed users toward Gemini on mobile platforms and will announce more features, compatibility, and migration arrangements before the transition.

@@@

cnBeta reports that Germany and Austria issued a joint statement on November 18 proposing the “Europeanization” of TikTok’s European business, with control by European capital, and called on other EU member states to join the initiative. German State Minister for Culture and Media Weimer and Austrian State Secretary for Digital Affairs Ploier advocate changing the ownership structure of TikTok’s European business and requiring control of key technical facilities such as recommendation algorithms. They said TikTok has about 200 million monthly active users in Europe, with about one-third of the population in Germany and Austria using it, and expressed concern that ByteDance, as its Chinese parent company, could obtain European user data under Chinese legal mechanisms. Previously, Ireland’s Data Protection Commission fined TikTok 530 million euros for transferring European user data to China and because personnel in China could access relevant data. Germany and Austria plan to promote the initiative during the EU ministerial meeting in Brussels on November 20; however, the European Commission tends to regulate according to law rather than intervene in capital ownership, and Europe also lacks a forced-sale mechanism. U.S. legislation in 2024 required the sale of TikTok’s U.S. business, and in January 2026 ByteDance agreed to establish a joint venture controlled by U.S. investors while retaining a 19.9% stake. At present, there is no confirmed acquisition consortium or transaction valuation, and no forced acquisition has been launched.

@@@

According to Readhub, DeepSeek’s operating entity, Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., recently completed a business registration change, adding a shareholder holding platform, Hangzhou Chengyan Enterprise Management Consulting Partnership (Limited Partnership), and increasing registered capital from about 16.4475 million yuan to about 19.9187 million yuan, an increase of about 21.1%. This funding round was 100 billion to 105.5 billion yuan, with a post-money valuation of about 615.5 billion yuan; together with the first round of about 51 billion yuan in June 2026, the two rounds have attracted more than 150 billion yuan in total. Founder Liang Wenfeng directly and indirectly holds about 67.42% in total and still controls the company. Hangzhou Chengyan also completed a change, adding 31 partners from multiple fields, covering industries across the upstream and downstream of large-model commercialization as well as leading investment institutions; external shareholders enjoy indirect economic returns only through this platform.

@@@

According to Zhidongxi, Tencent’s Hunyuan team held an AMA on Reddit, discussing the Hy4 series of models. Yao Shunyu also appeared in the comments section, though his specific account was not identified. Previously, Tencent opened the Hy4 weights and released a safety evaluation card, and also launched Hy4 flash. In response to Zhidongxi’s question about whether it can narrow the gap with the frontier under restricted access to advanced AI chips, the Hunyuan team said it is making the fullest possible use of existing resources to catch up with the frontier. The team revealed that the next-generation Hy model will further significantly expand parameter scale and continue to invest in large-scale reinforcement learning; Hy4 still has considerable room for improvement in post-training. Hy4-mini is already on the development roadmap, and Flash-Lite and models for devices with 24GB of VRAM are being planned. Technically, Hy4 adopts MLA because DSA reduces the computational overhead of MLA in the decoding stage; Hy4 flash adopts SWA, shrinking the KV Cache size by 4 times. Hy4 flash has 224B total parameters, including 64B Engram, with 12B activated per token; in a blind test with 85 internal users and 259 tasks, the cost per task was about 0.26 yuan, 1/20 that of Hy4.

@@@

According to Readhub, at the launch event for HarmonyOS Intelligent Mobility’s Stelato V8 and the Xingmang brand, Huawei officially introduced a new sub-brand, OSTA Xingmang, and its first HarmonyOS AI phone, the Xingmang O1 Pro, also made its debut. The report says the Xingmang O1 Pro achieves three major breakthroughs—new interaction, new technology, and new experience—and debuts HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition, opening up an all-new HarmonyOS AI experience. At the event, Liu He, general manager of the OSTA Xingmang brand, took the stage for the first time.

@@@

cnBeta reports that Leapmotor founder and CEO Zhu Jiangming and Opel CEO Florian Huettl have formally signed an agreement to jointly develop an all-new C-segment SUV, planned for sale in 2028, to be produced at a plant in Zaragoza, Spain, with a total agreement value of 100 million euros. The two project teams have already been working at joint project centers in Hangzhou and Rüsselsheim, Germany; the new car will use Leapmotor core components while integrating Opel’s design language, cabin ergonomics, chassis engineering, and lighting and seat technology. The project code is O3U, based on an electric platform shared with the Leapmotor B10. Leapmotor will complete vehicle development, while Opel will be responsible for exterior design, targeting annual output of about 50,000 vehicles; Huettl said the cooperation can compress the development cycle to less than two years. Previously, Stellantis invested about 1.5 billion euros in October 2023 for about a 21% stake in Leapmotor, and in May 2024 the two sides established Leapmotor International, responsible for sales and production of Leapmotor products outside Greater China. On October 16, the Leapmotor B10 went into mass production at the Zaragoza plant, and on the same day Leapmotor’s third-quarter financial report showed global deliveries of 310,052 units and revenue of 31.7 billion yuan for the quarter, both record highs.

@@@

According to TechWeb, NetEase’s Hong Kong shares opened lower and continued to decline, falling 18.41% as of press time. NetEase’s third-quarter report showed that revenue from games and related value-added services declined year on year for the first time in two years: third-quarter net revenue was 27.9 billion yuan, down 1.8% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 8.4 billion yuan, down about 2.5% year on year; gaming revenue was 22.9 billion yuan, down 1.7% year on year. In the first and second quarters of this year, the business grew 6.9% and 9.7% year on year respectively, with the last decline in the third quarter of 2024. Affected by the gaming business, the third-quarter gross margin fell sequentially to 69%. On the evening of November 19, at the earnings call, NetEase founder and CEO William Ding responded to the impact of short dramas, saying that short dramas have exploded this year and are highly effective at attracting user attention, and will indeed affect games in the short term; management said the experience of players actively operating and receiving feedback is still hard to replace, and AI is expected to enable more gameplay through interactive film-games and other forms. QuestMobile’s November report said short-drama videos and short videos are the two major engines of user time growth, with time accelerating toward micro-dramas and AI applications.

@@@

Alright, that’s all for today’s show! Thank you for spending time with us. May you have sweet dreams, and let’s keep chatting next time! If you like our show, you’re very welcome to subscribe and share it with your friends—it helps us a lot. See you next episode!

item.description:
Hi~~ Good evening, everyone! Today is Thursday, November 19, 2026. Welcome to Goodnight Coffee. I’m your host, An’an. Today let’s talk about the latest hot business and tech updates. Listen easy, chat happily—ready? Let’s go!

@@@

cnBeta reports that on Wednesday local time, November 18, Moody’s lowered its outlook on Nvidia’s credit rating to “stable” from “positive,” citing the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang and the company’s lack of a formal succession plan. Moody’s said Nvidia’s market leadership and financial position remain strong, but there is little room for a rating upgrade over the next 12 to 18 months. Huang’s departure brings uncertainty to business strategy and financial policy, and could affect a growth strategy that relies on relationships across the AI ecosystem. A government investigation into the resignation could also distract management. Moody’s also noted that proposed interim rules from the U.S. Commerce Department could tighten reviews of remote access to cloud computing and export controls on advanced semiconductors, potentially affecting Nvidia’s sales. Nvidia has set up a standing committee to oversee national security policy, export control compliance and global trade risk management. Nvidia’s five-year CDS stood at 121 basis points on Wednesday, down about 20 basis points from a week earlier. Traders believe Huang’s departure could limit debt issuance and ease credit pressure.

@@@

36Kr reports that Google has released Neon, a new member of the Gemini 4 family. Positioned between the flagship Carbon and the everyday efficiency model Hydrogen, Neon targets complex coding, analytical reasoning and enterprise workflows. It is three times faster than Carbon and costs only 60% as much. Neon is priced at USD 3 per million input tokens and USD 15 per million output tokens, with cached input as low as USD 0.15. It has a 1-million-token context window and supports four levels of thinking depth. It ranks No. 3 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with 61 points, No. 2 on the Vals Index at 70.9%, and No. 2 on the Agent Arena Index with 1,336 points. It ranks first on enterprise benchmarks such as Legal Research Bench and Tax Agent Bench, as well as three science and math benchmarks: Terminal-Bench Science, RiemannBench and HLE-Diamond. Google says it supports multi-file “surgical edits” and has launched Neon for Cyber, covering secure code, vulnerability discovery, verification and patching. It will be opened to trusted defenders through the Fairwind Program in the coming days. It is already rolling out across the Gemini app, API and enterprise channels. Meanwhile, Google’s world model Genie 4, announced on October 28, is now officially live. Users can change environments in real time with natural language while browsing, and native audio has been added for the first time.

@@@

cnBeta reports that OpenAI has released a technical report on chip design, disclosing that AI models are moving further into low-level circuit and microarchitecture optimization. They have participated in the design of its in-house inference chip Jalapeño, AMD’s flagship GPUs and next-generation CPUs, and open-source RISC-V processors. OpenAI used GPT-4o in the Jalapeño design, optimizing adder, multiplier and dot-product circuits, reducing multiplier and adder area by about 15% each and cutting multiplier latency from two cycles to one. Ultimately, vector unit area was reduced by about 13% and matrix unit area by about 10%, confirmed during silicon bring-up. In its work with AMD, the model rewrote SystemVerilog RTL code for key IP modules, improving PPA by up to 14% and achieving in under five months progress that normally takes about a year. Some results have been used in AMD designs recently submitted for manufacturing and incorporated into future versions, while key modules for the next-generation flagship CPU achieved single-digit percentage PPA improvements. In evaluations on open-source PicoRV32 and Ibex, GPT-6.2 Astra had the highest average score on RTL optimization tasks, across 9,881 scored runs. In the next phase, OpenAI will work with Synopsys to train GPT-Synopsys. The results are concentrated in specific modules and evaluation tasks and do not mean an entire GPU or CPU achieved the same proportional gains.

@@@

36Kr, citing Jiemian News, reports that Anthropic is scheduled to list on Nasdaq on November 19 local time under the ticker ANT. The IPO is priced at USD 83 per share, above earlier estimates. The offering consists of 980 million Class A ordinary shares, with the company selling about 956 million shares and selling shareholders selling about 23.65 million shares. The fully diluted valuation is about USD 1.5 trillion. The public offering raised about USD 81.3 billion, and with a USD 26 billion private placement, total fundraising exceeded USD 107 billion, setting a new global IPO record and surpassing SpaceX’s USD 75 billion base deal size. Seven co-founders each hold about 1.4%, and after listing each will have a paper fortune of over USD 10 billion. They will lock in 50.1% voting power through Class F shares. Sacra estimates that about 2,800 current and former employees may each have at least USD 1 million in pre-tax vested equity value. Hill estimates that 598 non-founder employees will each have more than USD 100 million in paper equity value. Altimeter’s CEO said the IPO was 10 to 20 times oversubscribed. Huatai Securities said its listing will become an important window for observing U.S. stock profitability. Masayoshi Son said not investing in Anthropic was a mistake.

@@@

cnBeta reports that Samsung Electronics’ new AI glasses, Intelligent Eyewear, opened pre-sales simultaneously in Korea and the U.S. on November 12, with initial inventory selling out within hours. The product is set for official sale on December 10. All 16 color and style versions on the Korean website show sold out and cannot be ordered, and all 30 versions in the U.S. market are also sold out. The glasses were jointly developed by Samsung and Google, with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker completing the exterior design. Korea is offering only 16 Gentle Monster collaboration versions, while the U.S. includes two series totaling 30 versions. They are priced at KRW 650,000 to 700,000, or about USD 450 to 500. The device weighs 41 grams, offers 9 hours of battery life on a single charge—9 grams lighter and 1 hour longer than Meta’s latest model—and has 64GB of storage, twice that of competitors. It features two AI assistants, Google Gemini and Samsung Bixby, can recognize the wearer’s field of view in real time, supports translation, interpretation and search, and an LED indicator lights up when recording to prevent privacy abuse. Samsung plans to follow its Galaxy smartphones with a premium strategy to catch up with Meta in the AI glasses race. Counterpoint data shows Meta held an 86% share in the first half of this year.

@@@

cnBeta reports that, hit by Q3 AI capex beating expectations and short-term profit pressure, Tencent Holdings’ Hong Kong shares fell 6.12% to HKD 350 on November 19, the lowest since August 2024. Alibaba and Kuaishou fell 5%, Meituan fell 3%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell about 2.5%. Tencent’s Q3 revenue was RMB 207.336 billion, up 8% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 63.612 billion, up 0.8%. Tencent Cloud revenue rose 35%, while WorkBuddy and MaaS revenue surged. Capex was RMB 81.433 billion, up 527% year on year, and RMB 166.153 billion for the first nine months, up 179%, mainly invested in AI infrastructure and model R&D. Executives said compute restrictions reduce available compute in the short term and put pressure on training; next-generation models may take longer, and over the long term this may push companies toward domestic chips and domestic supply chains. Morgan Stanley cut its target price by nearly 13% to HKD 480 while maintaining Overweight, and Citi maintained Buy. Tencent repurchased about HKD 7 billion in Q3, down 65% from the 2025 quarterly average of HKD 20 billion. As an anchor for Hang Seng Tech weighting and southbound funds, Tencent is seeing the market reassess its cash flow pressure.

@@@

According to Sina Tech, Lenovo Group announced on November 19 its results for the second quarter of fiscal 2026/27 ended September 30, 2026. Revenue exceeded RMB 200 billion for the first time, up nearly 50% year on year and a record high. Adjusted net profit rose 166% year on year, a record high and far above market expectations. Adjusted net margin rose 2 percentage points year on year to 4.5%, the highest since the acquisitions of Motorola Mobility and IBM’s x86 server business. In the quarter, ISG and SSG together contributed 61% of the total operating profit of the three business groups, up 28 percentage points from a year earlier. Lenovo is gradually forming a new pattern in which intelligent devices, infrastructure, and solutions and services jointly drive profit growth. Lenovo Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing said AI in enterprises is still at the introduction and trial stage, and the company is confident in the long-term growth of AI compute demand. The report noted that AI is moving from being training-dominated to a balance of training and inference; global token consumption is growing rapidly; cloud service providers continue to advance AI infrastructure; enterprise customers are moving from pilot exploration to scaled applications. Lenovo has been making strategic arrangements for more than a decade, and this quarter is seeing a concentrated realization of its transformation results.

@@@

Sina Tech reports that Pony.ai announced its Q3 2026 financial results: total revenue was RMB 299 million, a record quarterly high, up 75.2% year on year and 23.1% quarter on quarter. Robotaxi revenue was RMB 119 million, up 165.4% year on year and 47.1% quarter on quarter, with quarter-on-quarter growth accelerating from Q2. Its revenue share rose to 39.9%, approaching 40% for the first time, compared with 26.3% a year earlier. Growth mainly came from expanded commercial operations of its seventh-generation vehicles, higher vehicle delivery revenue from jointly built fleets at home and abroad, and passenger fare revenue up nearly 400% year on year. All seventh-generation Robotaxi models developed with Toyota, BAIC and GAC have entered fully driverless commercial operation, with expanded deployments at home and abroad. Founder and CEO Peng Jun said safety and R&D investment are translating into market access, scaled operations and cost advantages; renewal insurance premiums per vehicle for seventh-generation models fell 19%. During the period, fully driverless Robotaxi services advanced in first-tier and other Chinese cities. Guangzhou’s operating area exceeded 1,000 square kilometers, with Nansha connected contiguously to downtown districts, enabling cross-district travel across the city.

@@@

According to Readhub, Doubao officially announced that just three months after launch, Doubao Work’s workday active users exceeded 8 million and enterprise customer annual recurring revenue exceeded RMB 2 billion. Doubao Work is Doubao’s AI product and brand for productivity scenarios, and it has continued to update professional office capabilities since launch. On November 16, Doubao Work launched its Workbench feature, initially covering 21 professional scenarios including finance, healthcare, education and creative design, with preconfigured skills and tools, and support for users to create, save and share custom workbenches. Recently, Doubao Work also integrated third-party models such as Kimi, GLM and DeepSeek, labeling quota consumption multipliers for different models so users can choose independently based on task needs and usage costs.

According to Readhub, Xiaomi Auto has officially entered the UAE market, with official pre-sales handled by Gargash Prime under the local century-old Gargash Group. The pre-sale includes three models—SU7, YU7 and the range-extended SUV SkyNomad—with 13 versions in total, starting at about RMB 310,000, RMB 336,000 and RMB 380,000 respectively. item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话：Anthropic IPO创纪录，OpenAI AI芯片设计，英伟达CEO辞职
item.description:
嗨~~大家晚上好呀！今天是2026年11月19日，星期四，欢迎来到晚安咖啡，我是主播安安。今天咱们一起聊聊新鲜热乎的商业科技动态，轻松听、开心聊，准备好就出发吧！

@@@

cnBeta消息，当地时间周三（18日），穆迪将英伟达信用评级展望从“正面”下调至“稳定”，理由是首席执行官黄仁勋辞职且公司缺乏正式继任计划。穆迪称，英伟达市场领导地位和财务状况仍强劲，但未来12至18个月评级几乎没有上调空间；黄仁勋离职给业务战略和财务政策带来不确定性，可能影响依赖人工智能生态关系网络的增长战略，政府对辞职事件的调查也可能分散管理层注意力。穆迪还提到，美国商务部提议的临时规则或加强云计算远程访问审查和先进半导体出口管制，可能影响英伟达销售。英伟达已成立常设委员会，监督国家安全政策、出口管制合规和全球贸易风险管理。英伟达五年期CDS周三报121个基点，较一周前下降约20个基点；交易员认为黄仁勋离职或限制举债规模，缓解信用压力。

@@@

36氪消息，谷歌发布Gemini 4家族新成员Neon，定位介于旗舰Carbon和日常高效模型Hydrogen之间，面向复杂编程、分析推理和企业工作流，速度是Carbon的3倍，成本只有其60%。Neon每百万输入、输出token定价分别为3美元和15美元，缓存输入低至0.15美元，上下文窗口100万token，支持4档思考深度。它以61分列Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index第3，Vals Index以70.9%列第2，Agent Arena Index以1336分列第2；Legal Research Bench、Tax Agent Bench等企业评测及Terminal-Bench Science、RiemannBench、HLE-Diamond三项科学数学基准居首。谷歌称其支持多文件“手术式编辑”，并推出覆盖安全代码、漏洞发现验证修补的Neon for Cyber，未来几天经Fairwind Program向受信任防御人员开放。Gemini应用、API和企业渠道已开始滚动上线。同时，谷歌10月28日官宣的世界模型Genie 4已正式上线，用户可在浏览中用自然语言实时改变环境，并首次加入原生音频。

@@@

cnBeta消息，OpenAI发布芯片设计技术报告，披露AI模型正进一步进入芯片底层电路和微架构优化，已参与自研推理芯片Jalapeño、AMD旗舰GPU和下一代CPU及开源RISC-V处理器设计。OpenAI用GPT-4o参与Jalapeño设计，优化加法器、乘法器和点积电路，使乘法器和加法器面积各减约15%，乘法器延迟由两周期降至一周期；最终向量单元面积减约13%、矩阵单元减约10%，已在硅片调试中确认。与AMD合作中，模型重写关键IP模块的SystemVerilog RTL代码，使PPA最高改善14%，不到五个月完成通常约一年进展；部分成果已用于AMD近期提交制造的设计并纳入未来版本，下一代旗舰CPU关键模块获个位数百分比PPA改善。开源PicoRV32和Ibex评估中，GPT-6.2 Astra在RTL优化任务平均得分最高，评估共9881次计分运行。下一阶段OpenAI将与Synopsys合作训练GPT-Synopsys。成果集中于特定模块和评估任务，不等同整颗GPU或CPU获得同比例提升。

@@@

36氪援引界面新闻消息称，Anthropic定于当地时间11月19日登陆纳斯达克，代码ANT，IPO定价每股83美元，高于此前预估。此次发行9.8亿股A类普通股，公司售出约9.56亿股，售股股东售出约2365万股；完全稀释估值约1.5万亿美元，公开发行募资约813亿美元，加260亿美元私募配售，总募资超1070亿美元，创全球IPO新纪录，超过SpaceX的750亿美元基础交易规模。七位联合创始人各持约1.4%，上市后每人账面身家均破百亿美元，并通过F类股票锁定50.1%投票权。Sacra估算，约2800名现任及前任员工每人税前已归属股权价值可能至少达100万美元；Hill测算，598名非创始人员工每人股权账面价值将超1亿美元。Altimeter CEO称IPO超额认购10至20倍，华泰证券称其上市后将成观察美股盈利的重要窗口；孙正义称未投资Anthropic是错误。

@@@

cnBeta消息，三星电子新款AI眼镜Intelligent Eyewear于11月12日在韩国、美国同步开启预售，备货量数小时内售罄；该产品定于12月10日正式发售。韩国官网16款不同配色、款式版本均显示售罄、无法下单，美国市场30款版本也全部售罄。这款眼镜由三星与谷歌联合开发，并携手Gentle Monster、Warby Parker完成外观设计；韩国仅发售Gentle Monster联名16款，美国包含两大系列共30款。售价为65万至70万韩元，约450至500美元。整机重41克，单次充电续航9小时，比Meta最新款轻9克、续航多1小时；存储容量64GB，为竞品两倍。设备搭载谷歌Gemini和三星Bixby两大AI助手，可实时识别佩戴者视野，支持翻译、解读、搜索，拍摄时LED指示灯会亮起以防隐私滥用。三星计划继Galaxy智能手机后，以高端策略在AI眼镜赛道追赶Meta；Counterpoint数据显示，今年上半年Meta在该市场份额为86%。

@@@

cnBeta消息，受三季报AI资本开支超预期、短期利润承压影响，腾讯控股11月19日港股跌6.12%至350港元，创2024年8月以来新低；阿里、快手跌5%，美团跌3%，恒生科技指数跌约2.5%。腾讯三季度营收2073.36亿元、同比增8%，归母净利润636.12亿元、增0.8%；腾讯云收入增35%，WorkBuddy、MaaS收入大增，资本开支814.33亿元、同比增527%，前三季1661.53亿元、增179%，主要投向AI基础设施和模型研发。高管称算力限制短期减少可用算力、训练承压，下一代模型或需更长时间，长期或推动企业转向国产芯片及国内供应链。摩根士丹利下调目标价近13%至480港元、维持超配，花旗维持买入。腾讯三季度回购约70亿港元，较2025年季均200亿港元降65%；腾讯是恒生科技权重与南向资金“锚”，市场正重估其现金流压力。

@@@

据新浪科技报道，联想集团11月19日公布截至2026年9月30日的2026/27财年第二季度业绩：营收首次突破2000亿元人民币，同比增长近50%，创历史新高；调整后净利润同比增长166%，创历史新高并远超市场预期；调整后净利润率同比提升2个百分点至4.5%，刷新自收购摩托罗拉移动和IBM x86服务器业务以来的历史纪录。本季度，ISG基础设施方案业务集团与SSG方案服务业务集团合计贡献三大业务集团运营利润总额的61%，较去年同期提升28个百分点，联想集团正逐步形成智能设备、基础设施与方案服务共同驱动利润增长的新格局。联想集团董事长兼CEO杨元庆表示，AI在企业目前还只是引入和尝试阶段，公司对AI算力需求的长期增长充满信心。报道提到，AI正从训练为主走向训练与推理并重，全球Token消耗量快速增长，云服务厂商持续推进AI基建，企业客户从试点探索走向规模化应用；联想集团已进行十余年战略布局，本季度正迎来转型成果集中兑现。

据Readhub消息，豆包官方宣布，豆包工作上线仅三个月，工作日活跃用户数突破800万，企业客户年度经常性收入突破20亿元。豆包工作是豆包面向生产力场景推出的AI产品及品牌，自发布以来持续更新专业办公能力。11月16日，豆包工作上线“工作台”功能，首批覆盖金融、医疗、教育、创意设计等21个专业场景，预先配置相应技能和工具，并支持用户创建、保存和分享自定义工作台。近期，豆包工作还接入了Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek等第三方模型，标注不同模型的额度消耗倍率，方便用户结合任务需求和使用成本自主选择。

item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话（英文版）：英伟达财报超预期，Anthropic IPO火爆
item.description:
Hi everyone~~ Good evening! It’s Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Welcome to Goodnight Coffee—I’m your host, An’an! Tonight I’ll walk you through some interesting business and tech stories. We’ll keep it light and fun, and wrap up today on an upbeat note. Ready? Let’s get started!

@@@

According to CNBC, NVIDIA shares rose 3.72% in Wednesday premarket trading after the company once again reported better-than-expected results. Its third-quarter revenue was $115.84 billion, more than $6 billion above analysts’ $109.10 billion estimate; fourth-quarter revenue guidance was $130 billion, above LSEG’s $125.1 billion consensus. Boosted by the results, new cloud providers CoreWeave, Nebius, and Iren rose 6.1%, 8.2%, and 7.2%, respectively. Shortly before the earnings release, CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week, made his first public statement, saying he was willing to return to the company after several prominent tech figures voiced support. But new board chair Harvey Jones—NVIDIA’s first-ever board chair—said on the earnings call that the board does not plan to have Huang serve as CEO again. Interim CEO Colette Kress told CNBC that hyperscalers are urgently seeking more available compute, that claims of a shift in customer types are not true, and that all types of customers are still working with NVIDIA, whose customer base is very broad. The US Commerce Department announced regulatory adjustments on Monday to restrict Chinese companies’ remote access to compute in overseas data centers, aiming to stop China from obtaining NVIDIA’s most advanced chips. NVIDIA said in its earnings commentary that its outlook assumes no data center compute revenue from China.

@@@

According to a report from Jiemian News published with authorization from 36Kr, Gerstner, CEO of Altimeter Capital, said the firm applied to subscribe for $5 billion worth of shares in Anthropic’s IPO—its largest allocation request in 20 years. The IPO is 10 to 20 times oversubscribed, and the order book is more than five times the size of the previous largest IPO order. However, the request has not yet been filled, and the oversubscription multiple is based on its own market judgment. Anthropic plans to price the deal local time on November 18 and list on Nasdaq the next day under the ticker ANT, with an offering range of $70 to $78. The IPO could raise up to $64.4 billion, plus a private placement of about $26 billion, for a total of up to $90.4 billion. At the top end, the fully diluted valuation would be about $1.4 trillion. Investors including Sequoia, Iconiq, Lightspeed, Accel, and Altimeter plan to subscribe billions of dollars. Private placement participants include Google and NVIDIA at $10 billion each, AMD at $2.5 billion, Broadcom, Micron, and Microsoft at $1 billion each, and a TSMC affiliate at $500 million. After completion, Amazon and Google will hold 14.7% and 13.7% of outstanding shares, respectively.

@@@

According to Readhub, Microsoft has launched six AI models spanning coding, cybersecurity, image generation, and voice. Its coding model MAI Code 2 delivers 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol’s performance at only 40% of the price; against Claude Opus 5.5, it reaches 96% performance at just 5% of the cost. Cybersecurity model MAI Cyber 2 Flash outperformed GPT-6 Astra in relevant security tests, with per-task cost less than 2% of the latter’s. Image model MAI Image 2.7 ranked first in image editing. Mustafa Suleyman, Microsoft’s AI chief, said the company is accelerating work on its own general AI models to reduce dependence on external models, and plans to open model weights to enterprises so customers can customize models with their own data.

@@@

According to CNBC, JPMorgan is testing with Hyundai Card how AI agents can handle financial transactions without direct human intervention and assessing whether they could eventually negotiate and make payments with each other. The two companies have completed an initial proof of concept simulating an FX transaction. In the test, Hyundai Card’s AI agent requested an FX transaction to maintain euro liquidity in its Kinexys blockchain deposit account. JPMorgan said this was the first test of an autonomous bank agent versus a client agent on a private blockchain for corporate treasury management. Wee Kee Toh, global head of Kinexys Insights at JPMorgan, said the next step will be to test autonomous agents going beyond executing transactions and interacting with one another in the ecosystem—the biggest part of expanding the first phase. The two companies plan to launch a more complex phase involving multiple AI agents in the first half of 2027. After the initial trial, JPMorgan has not set a commercialization timetable. Toh said the biggest obstacle is not the technology itself, but governance, internal controls, and accountability and risk without direct human oversight. AvePoint’s 2026 State of AI report shows that unauthorized autonomous agent behavior is the third most common AI agent-related security vulnerability, affecting 34.1% of companies that reported such incidents. CEO Tianyi Jiang warned that agent interactions can amplify errors; in the worst case, a compromised or hallucinating agent gives bad data to another, potentially triggering a high-speed cascade of erroneous fund transfers before humans notice.

@@@

According to TechWeb, JD.com announced unaudited results for the three months ended September 30, 2026: revenue was RMB309.6 billion, up 3.5% year over year; operating profit was RMB5.2 billion, compared with a loss of RMB1.1 billion a year earlier, swinging to profit; net income attributable to shareholders was RMB6.5 billion, compared with RMB5.3 billion a year earlier; non-GAAP net income attributable to shareholders was RMB8.3 billion, up 44%. By segment, JD Retail revenue was RMB257.966 billion, up 2.9%, with operating profit of RMB15.1 billion and a 5.8% margin; JD Logistics revenue was RMB63.953 billion, up 16.1%; new business revenue was RMB7.831 billion, down 49.8%, with an operating loss of RMB9.642 billion, narrowing from RMB15.736 billion a year earlier, as JD Food Delivery and Jingxi drove a clear reduction in losses. Marketing expenses were RMB15.5 billion, down 26.2%; operating margin was 1.7%, compared with negative 0.4% a year earlier. JD completed its voluntary public takeover offer for CECONOMY at €1.335 billion, acquiring 59.8% of share capital and voting rights; CECONOMY has been consolidated since November 12. As of September 30, cash and short-term investments totaled RMB214.7 billion; third-quarter free cash flow was negative RMB23.861 billion.

@@@

According to TechWeb, after new US export control rules took effect, a $480 million loan for ByteDance to buy NVIDIA GPUs in Malaysia was halted. At least five banks evaluating the deal have internally discussed withdrawing or not participating, and one banker said the loan is “effectively dead.” The financing was borrowed by Singapore cloud provider Aolani Cloud and led by DBS Group; the funds were to buy NVIDIA GPUs in Malaysia and then lease the compute to ByteDance for remote use. On November 16, the US Bureau of Industry and Security designated Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil as high-risk transshipment countries; exports, reexports, or in-country transfers of advanced AI chips to these countries require US licenses. The new rules also regulate remote access: if an operating entity knows or should know that the end user is in China, and the aggregate processing performance exceeds 12 million—roughly equivalent to 700 to 800 H100s—the relevant chip supply must undergo license review. Banks are not worried about ByteDance’s ability to repay, but that once they lend, they could become liable for violating US export controls. Aolani said it is coordinating with regulators and financing partners to ensure compliance. As of publication, ByteDance had not publicly commented.

据CNBC报道，摩根大通正与韩国现代信用卡测试AI代理如何在无直接人工干预下处理金融交易，并评估其最终能否相互谈判和付款。两家公司已完成一项模拟外汇交易的初步概念验证。测试中，现代信用卡的AI代理请求进行外汇交易，以维持其在Kinexys区块链存款账户中的欧元流动性；摩根大通称，这是首个基于私有区块链、面向企业财资管理的自主银行代理对客户代理测试。摩根大通Kinexys Insights全球主管Wee Kee Toh表示，下一步将测试自主代理不再局限于执行交易、而是在生态系统中彼此互动，这是扩大第一阶段范围的最大部分；两家公司计划2027年上半年启动涉及多个AI代理的更复杂阶段。初步试验完成后，摩根大通尚未设定商业化时间表。Toh称，技术本身并非最大障碍，更难的是治理、内部控制以及无直接人工监督下的责任和风险。AvePoint《2026年AI现状》报告显示，未经授权的自主代理行为是第三常见的AI代理相关安全漏洞，影响34.1%报告此类事件的公司。其首席执行官Tianyi Jiang警告，代理互动可能放大错误，最坏情况下，一个被入侵或产生幻觉的代理向另一个提供错误数据，可能在人类察觉前引发高速连锁的错误资金转移。

cnBeta援引彭博社报道，Anthropic预计11月19日或20日登陆纳斯达克，寻求1.4万亿美元估值。公司计划通过IPO和一项独立私募配售合计融资最多904亿美元，规模将超过SpaceX IPO的750亿美元基础融资，成为有史以来最大上市交易；知情人士称，此次IPO已获近七倍超额认购。Anthropic拟发行8.25亿股，发行价每股70至78美元。截至10月31日，公司年化营收810亿美元，较9月底增加100亿美元；现金及等价物超过1300亿美元。高盛预计其2030年才能实现年度自由现金流为正；到2045年支出承诺超9000亿美元，其中约710亿美元在2027年9月底前到期。上周五，CEO阿莫代伊与摩根大通CEO戴蒙在纽约IPO活动上同台推介；知情人士称，Anthropic不准中国大陆和香港机构投资者参与IPO认购。此前黄仁勋声誉危机致英伟达股价重挫，Anthropic被寄望接替英伟达成为AI新标杆。

@@@

据The Verge报道，彭博社记者马克·古尔曼称，苹果计划在2027年6月的全球开发者大会（WWDC）上发布首款智能眼镜，并在当年年底前开始出货。该产品不配备增强现实功能，核心卖点是新版Siri人工智能和iPhone应用生态。原型代号N50，目前运行精简版visionOS，采用基于旧款智能手表芯片的新处理器。眼镜配有类似MagSafe的扁平矩形磁吸充电器，大小约相当于一粒Tic Tac，用户戴着眼镜也能充电。苹果还强调外观、隐私和音质，员工称其音质达到行业领先水平，支持通话、音乐播放和FaceTime音频。眼镜具备Wi-Fi，离开iPhone后，部分非第三方应用功能仍可继续使用，例如通过Wi-Fi继续听音频，但它不会成为完全独立的设备。新版Siri将增加对应用的细粒度控制，苹果先让开发者在iPhone上适配，以期眼镜推出后能直接使用相关功能。

@@@

据The Verge报道，美国联合发射联盟（ULA）的“火神”（Vulcan）火箭在一次发射中发生异常，未能将40颗亚马逊“Leo”卫星送入轨道。ULA在社交平台X发表声明称，根据发射主管收到的数据，这枚从41号航天发射复合体升空的火箭在飞行10分钟后出现异常，导致亚马逊任务未能入轨；目前尚不清楚故障原因，公司承诺在调查过程中保持透明。这据报是ULA成立20年来首次任务失败。此次发射原计划是亚马逊向ULA购买的38次发射中的第一次。“Leo”是亚马逊对标SpaceX“星链”的卫星项目，但此前进展艰难，迄今仅有少量所需卫星入轨。亚马逊表示，任何发射都有风险，首次任务尤其如此，ULA一直是其可信赖的合作伙伴，相信ULA会从此次任务中吸取教训，并落实“火神”的长期计划。

@@@

@@@

据新浪科技报道，腾讯文化发文披露，腾讯在28岁生日当天将一年一度总办LinkTime做成特别播客，总办就AI时代机会、挑战与选择发声。讲话提出，所有核心业务团队都要面向AI时代再创业：AI native业务、模型和产品要逆流而上，核心业务一半人守住、一半人打新战役，组织扁平化、以小团队作战，打破山头和中间传话阻碍。腾讯称要做以人为本的AI，坚持造福人类和社会、由人控制、赋能创造力；AI仍处早期，算力基建需自建且价格飞涨，投入会兼顾产出比。其AI金字塔以模型为核心，已进入国内第一梯队；小微定位私人AI助理，目标是“token自由”；元宝未来定位决策和资讯参谋；WorkBuddy在8个月内成为中国提供最多token的单一AI产品。总办还要求心态归零、加快反馈决策和行动、提升人才密度，并提到游戏、金融、安全等团队已与模型Co-Design带来Hy能力提升。

item.description:
Hi there~~ Good evening, everyone! Today is Monday, November 16, 2026. Welcome to Goodnight Coffee. I'm your host, An'an. Today we're going to talk about the latest business and tech developments—packed with useful insights, so stay tuned!

@@@

The Verge reports that events surrounding Nvidia co-founder and former CEO Jensen Huang are evolving rapidly. The report notes rumors that Jensen Huang may be looking for a path back to the CEO role. Meanwhile, Megaspeed issued a statement saying that Alice Huang has not worked at the company since August 2025. The report says the statement raises more questions than it answers. The Verge also says the latest issue of its Stepback newsletter has reviewed the situation, and since that morning, several new developments have emerged.

@@@

cnBeta, citing Bloomberg, reports that Anthropic is expected to list on Nasdaq on November 19 or 20, seeking a $1.4 trillion valuation. The company plans to raise up to $90.4 billion through an IPO and a separate private placement, which would exceed SpaceX's $75 billion base IPO raise and become the largest listing ever; people familiar with the matter say the IPO is nearly seven times oversubscribed. Anthropic plans to issue 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each. As of October 31, the company's annualized revenue was $81 billion, up $10 billion from the end of September; cash and equivalents exceed $130 billion. Goldman Sachs expects it to achieve positive annual free cash flow only in 2030; spending commitments by 2045 exceed $900 billion, about $71 billion of which comes due before the end of September 2027. Last Friday, CEO Amodei and JPMorgan CEO Dimon appeared together at an IPO event in New York to pitch the deal; people familiar with the matter say Anthropic will not allow institutional investors from mainland China and Hong Kong to participate in IPO subscriptions. Earlier, Jensen Huang's reputation crisis caused Nvidia shares to slump, and Anthropic is expected to succeed Nvidia as the new AI benchmark.

@@@

The Verge reports that Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says Apple plans to unveil its first smart glasses at its Worldwide Developers Conference in June 2027 and begin shipping them by the end of that year. The product will not have augmented reality features; its core selling points are the new Siri AI and the iPhone app ecosystem. The prototype is codenamed N50, currently runs a stripped-down version of visionOS, and uses a new processor based on an older smartwatch chip. The glasses come with a flat rectangular MagSafe-like magnetic charger about the size of a Tic Tac, and users can charge them while wearing them. Apple also emphasizes design, privacy and audio quality. Employees say its audio quality is industry-leading, and it supports calls, music playback and FaceTime audio. The glasses have Wi-Fi; after leaving the iPhone, some non-third-party app functions can still be used, such as continuing to listen to audio via Wi-Fi, but it will not be a fully independent device. The new Siri will add granular app controls; Apple is first having developers adapt on the iPhone so that related functions can be used directly once the glasses launch.

@@@

The Verge reports that United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket experienced an anomaly during a launch and failed to send 40 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit. ULA said in a statement on X that, according to data received by the launch director, the rocket, which lifted off from Space Launch Complex 41, experienced an anomaly 10 minutes after liftoff, causing the Amazon mission to fail to reach orbit; the cause is not yet known, and the company promised transparency during the investigation. This is reportedly ULA's first mission failure in its 20-year history. The launch was originally planned as the first of 38 launches Amazon purchased from ULA. Leo is Amazon's satellite project aimed at competing with SpaceX's Starlink, but it has struggled, with only a small number of the needed satellites in orbit so far. Amazon says any launch carries risk, especially a first mission; ULA has always been a trusted partner, and it believes ULA will learn from this mission and carry out Vulcan's long-term plan.

@@@

TechWeb, citing Kuaikeji, reports that on November 14, Judge Noelle Wise of the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California denied in full motions to dismiss by Samsung, Micron and SK Hynix, finding that the plaintiffs have plausibly alleged that the three violated Section 1 of the Sherman Act and reached an illegal agreement, moving the DRAM class-action antitrust lawsuit into substantive proceedings. The lawsuit was filed in June 2026 by 17 consumers and small businesses in five U.S. states, alleging that the three coordinated to restrict conventional DRAM supply and push up prices. The complaint says that as of the third quarter of 2025, the three together accounted for more than 91% of global DRAM revenue; since late 2022, they synchronized cuts to conventional consumer DRAM capacity, and in 2023 shifted substantial wafer capacity to HBM, with conventional DRAM prices cumulatively rising about 697% in 18 months. The court listed synchronized conduct including Samsung and SK Hynix refusing long-term supply agreements, the three delaying or halting new fabs, cutting DDR4 production in the same quarter, Micron closing its 30-year-old Crucial brand in December 2025, launching highly similar customer audit mechanisms in January 2026, and mentioned that they were involved in a price-fixing case from 1998 to 2002. The three companies say their decisions were adapting to changes in the AI market and that similar disputes were dismissed in 2018; the judge found the facts and evidence in this case fundamentally different. The three must submit complete answer documents by December 7, 2026, and the first management conference is set for January 12, 2027.

@@@

Sina Tech reports that on November 16, according to Qwen, Alibaba released its new-generation foundation model Qwen4-Max, with 2.4 trillion total parameters, native vision capabilities and support for a million-token context. Based on a new architecture and training optimizations, the model continues to evolve in key capabilities such as agents and coding, and in professional verticals such as finance and law it moves from "information retrieval" to "professional delivery." During the launch period, Qwen app members can try it free for a limited time, and using Qwen4-Max does not consume membership quota. Related reports show that its preview version first launched on November 11 on the Qwen AI platform Token Plan and was simultaneously integrated into Qwen Office, Qoder, the Qwen app and QwenStudio; the preview window runs until 24:00 on November 25, mainly for capability validation and collecting feedback. The Paper also reports that Qwen4-Max is now available via API on the Qwen AI platform, with cache hits as low as RMB0.5 per million tokens, and the average cost per completed task down 60% from the previous generation; users can also call it through Alibaba Token Plan, and the small- and medium-sized models in the Qwen4 series will be open-sourced successively.

@@@

Sina Tech reports that an article from Tencent Culture disclosed that on its 28th birthday, Tencent turned its annual Executive Office LinkTime into a special podcast, with the Executive Office speaking out on the opportunities, challenges and choices in the AI era. The remarks proposed that all core business teams must start a second venture for the AI era: AI-native businesses, models and products must go upstream against the current; half of the people in core businesses should defend the core, while the other half should fight new battles; the organization should be flattened and operate in small teams, breaking down fiefdoms and barriers of middle-layer relayed messaging. Tencent said it wants to build human-centered AI, adhering to benefiting humanity and society, being controlled by humans and empowering creativity; AI is still in its early stages, compute infrastructure must be self-built and prices are soaring, and investment will balance input and output efficiency. Its AI pyramid is centered on models and has entered China's first tier; Xiaowei is positioned as a personal AI assistant with the goal of "token freedom"; Yuanbao will be positioned as a decision-making and information adviser; WorkBuddy became the single AI product in China providing the most tokens within eight months. The Executive Office also required a zero-based mindset, faster feedback, decision-making and action, and higher talent density, and mentioned that teams in gaming, finance, security and other areas have already co-designed with models, bringing improvements in Hy capabilities.

@@@

Sina Tech reports that Huawei Terminal announced on the morning of November 16 that HarmonyOS terminal devices have exceeded 100 million units. Previously, Huawei's Executive Director and Chairman of the Terminal BG Yu Chengdong announced via social media that the new sub-brand OSTA Xingmang will officially debut on November 20 at the "HarmonyOS Intelligent Mobility Stelato V8 and Xingmang Brand Launch Event." Reports say Xingmang will share HarmonyOS, Kirin chip technology, and Huawei's online and offline channel and after-sales systems.

@@@

Sina Tech reports that on November 16, due to tight supply of compute resources, DeepSeek introduced usage limits for its consumer app and web chat services: long conversations that have lasted more than seven days without active interaction can no longer be continued; single input text is capped at about 40,000 characters; when the daily chat quota is exhausted, users will see the prompt "Server busy, usage limit reached." Analysts believe the move is intended to reclaim KV cache occupied by idle sessions and prioritize inference for active users. Since October, its services have come under pressure multiple times; the official status page has recorded eight incidents, occurring on October 2, October 8, October 12 (twice), October 15, October 20, October 27 and November 3, mostly performance degradation such as slower responses; the October 15 incident lasted more than four hours, with consumer services and the V4 Pro and V4.1 Flash APIs simultaneously restricted, and API users were later compensated with credits. From August to October, V4.1 Flash API availability was 99.46%, and V4 Pro was 99.74%. DeepSeek recently opened APIs for its full suite of applications, with time-of-use peak/off-peak pricing and separate concurrency limits on the API side. OpenRouter's weekly ranking shows that from October 19 to 25, V4.1-Flash-1017 ranked first with 33.6 trillion tokens in weekly calls, up 801% week-on-week.

@@@

Sina Tech reports that on November 12, xFusion's ChiNext IPO was approved at the listing review meeting. It took only 174 days from acceptance on May 22 to approval, and its RMB8 billion fundraising makes it the largest ChiNext IPO project this year. The company's revenue rose from RMB25.092 billion in 2023 to RMB58.246 billion in 2025, and was RMB37.286 billion in the first half of 2026, up 20.78% year-on-year; AI server revenue share rose from 25.03% to 53.29%. However, its main business gross margin fell from 14.27% to 8.58% in 2025, with a net margin of 1.77%; in the first half of 2026, gross margin rebounded to 15.49%, and net profit was RMB2.108 billion, more than twice the full-year 2025 figure. Its 2025 R&D expense ratio was 2.02%, lower than Sugon, Unisplendour and Inspur. In the first half of 2026, net operating cash flow was -RMB15.685 billion; accounts receivable were RMB15.303 billion, up more than 170% from the end of 2025; inventory was RMB35.662 billion, up 68%. As of the end of July 2026, its backlog was RMB30.113 billion, of which AI servers accounted for 73.70%.

@@@

All right, that's all for today's show! Thank you for spending time with us. I hope you're in a great mood tonight. If you like our show, you're very welcome to subscribe and share it with your friends—it really helps us. See you next time!

item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话（英文版）：字节4000亿估值回购，DeepSeek开放API，SpaceX捕获星舰
item.description:
Hi there~~ Good evening, everyone! Today is Sunday, November 15, 2026. I’m An’an, your host on Goodnight Coffee~ Tonight, let’s catch up on the latest business and tech headlines together—plenty of useful takeaways, and a relaxed, easy listen. So find a comfortable spot, and let’s get tonight’s show started!

@@@

According to TechWeb, citing foreign media, ByteDance plans to buy back up to $6 billion worth of shares from existing investors at a valuation of about $400 billion. The buyback price is $241.35 per share, up from $200.41 in the previous buyback last November. External shareholders have the right to require ByteDance to repurchase all of their holdings by a specified date. In its latest shareholder letter, ByteDance proposed extending that deadline again, from December 11 this year to December 11, 2030. ByteDance also said it plans to offer employees working on AI a total of 300 million shares tied to the value of the company’s AI business, as a way to reward and retain AI talent. Earlier reports showed that in the first half of 2026, ByteDance’s revenue was about $120 billion, up 30% year on year, with net profit of about $20 billion. The company also recently secured about $30 billion in loans from the banking system—its largest single loan to date.

@@@

According to QbitAI, DeepSeek has announced that it has officially opened up the API for its “full suite” of applications. Web search, deep-thinking search, file upload, link reading, speech recognition, and speech synthesis all now have standalone interfaces and can be called and billed separately. Voice capabilities are being opened up for the first time. Developers can combine them freely, or even recreate the complete DeepSeek App one-to-one. DeepSeek also open-sourced a lightweight chat front-end demo that supports importing chat history. Previously, Search and Fetch, opened on October 17, required developers to chain tool calls themselves. Now, once web search is enabled, DeepSeek can automatically decide when to search, what to search for, which web pages to read, and how to answer follow-up questions. V4.1-Flash already supports these conversation extensions through the Messages, Responses, and Chat Completions APIs. On pricing, speech recognition costs 0.78 yuan per hour at the original price, or 0.39 yuan at 50% off—about 1/4.6 of OpenAI GPT-Transcribe, 1/3.1 of GPT-4o mini Transcribe, and 1/16.5 of Google Cloud’s standard service. Speech synthesis drops from 3 yuan to 1.5 yuan per 10,000 characters; search and web scraping cost 5 yuan per 1,000 successful calls; and OCR costs 1.5 yuan per 1,000 pages. The announcement said the existing conversational product is only a relatively basic form.

@@@

According to Readhub, Huawei Executive Director Richard Yu released a video reviewing the development of Huawei’s Mate X series of foldable phones and announced that the Mate X8 is coming soon. At the end of the video, the new phone’s appearance was revealed. Yu said the new device has breakthroughs in the display, camera, and performance. Footage circulating online shows Yu holding a purple new phone believed to be the actual Mate X8, featuring a circular camera module. Related leaks say the Mate X8 is a large foldable with a conventional aspect ratio, equipped with a new 8-inch wide-color-gamut BOE display and ultra-flat crease technology, a rear 50MP 18EV ultra-large-sensor flagship camera system, an “N-generation Kirin chip,” and a large circular deco with a jewel-ring design.

@@@

Readhub reports that the large unmanned cargo aircraft W5000 has successfully completed its test flight. The aircraft was developed and manufactured in Changzhou, Jiangsu. All 220,000 of its components are domestically produced. It has a maximum payload of 5 tons and a maximum range of 2,600 kilometers. So far, W5000 has received 835 intended orders, with customers including several domestic logistics companies. According to plan, the aircraft is expected to enter commercial operation by the end of 2027.

@@@

According to Huxiu 24 Hours, 12 drugs from Hengrui Pharmaceuticals have been included in China’s 2026 national medical insurance drug list, three of them for the first time.

@@@

According to The Verge, SpaceX has for the first time successfully caught the Starship spacecraft itself using the robotic arms on its launch and catch tower, “Mechazilla.” The company had previously caught boosters multiple times using the “chopsticks” method, but this was the first time it completed the maneuver with the Starship vehicle. During this mission, SpaceX originally planned to catch the booster on Starship’s 15th flight, but the booster aborted its landing and then exploded over the Gulf of Mexico; the company is still investigating the cause. The report says that because the entire launch vehicle was not recovered, this was not a complete success, but it is still considered a milestone for the Starship program. Video shows Starship descending through the clouds, flipping vertically, and entering smoothly between Mechazilla’s waiting robotic arms at about 4:20 p.m. ET. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said on the third-quarter earnings call that these first flights are not guaranteed to succeed, but that the next flight is more likely than not to succeed.

@@@

According to Readhub, Nvidia’s board has issued a formal response to outside attention on the CEO candidate issue. The board said it is currently in the process of selecting an executive search firm and will launch recruitment for the company’s CEO position. The board explicitly stressed that, as of now, it has not had formal contact with any potential candidate, and speculation about any individual internal or external candidate is premature.

@@@

According to Readhub, Italy has issued an €805 million fine against Meta.

@@@

cnBeta reports that Google has launched a personal financial analysis feature for Gemini. The feature can connect to bank accounts and credit cards to help users analyze their personal income and expenses.

@@@

According to The Verge, Tesla has invited “select customers” to buy the two-seat, steering-wheel-free Cybercab for personal use at $29,990, but they must also subscribe to a $299-per-month “Autonomy Subscription.” The vehicle is only being sold in “supported service areas” covered by Tesla’s Robotaxi service, with limited initial supply. Buyers must also pay a $1,000 non-refundable deposit to secure a December delivery window, though delivery is not guaranteed. If the subscription is canceled, because the vehicle has no manual-driving fallback, the Cybercab will be completely unusable on public roads. The order terms also prohibit commercial use: it cannot be used for Uber or DoorDash, nor can it be connected to Tesla’s Robotaxi network to offset the subscription fee. Over a five-year ownership period, the mandatory subscription adds $17,940, bringing the base cost to about $47,600 before taxes, charging, and insurance—higher than a new Model 3 or Model Y. Tesla began offering Cybercab rides in its Austin Robotaxi service in September; according to Robotaxi Tracker, 278 Cybercabs are currently in operation, accounting for about 40% of the fleet. Tesla AI head Ashok Elluswamy has suggested that customer vehicles may be allowed to join the network in the second quarter of 2027.

@@@

All right, that wraps up today’s show! Thank you for spending this time with us. May you carry a good mood with you as you keep moving forward. If you enjoy our program, we’d really appreciate it if you subscribe and share it with your friends—it helps us a lot. See you next time!

item.title: 《晚安咖啡》科技夜话：字节4000亿估值回购，DeepSeek开放API，SpaceX捕获星舰
item.description:
嗨~~大家晚上好呀！今天是2026年11月15日，星期日，我是晚安咖啡的主播安安～今天咱们一起聊聊新鲜的商业科技动态，干货满满、轻松开听，快找个舒服的姿势，和我一起开启今晚的分享吧！

@@@

据TechWeb援引外媒消息，字节跳动计划以约4000亿美元估值，从现有投资者手中回购不超过60亿美元股份。此次回购价格为每股241.35美元，高于去年11月上一轮回购的每股200.41美元。外部股东有权要求字节跳动在特定日期前回购其全部持股，字节跳动在最新股东信中提议，将这一期限从今年12月11日再次延长至2030年12月11日。字节跳动还表示，计划向从事AI业务的员工提供合计3亿股与公司AI业务价值挂钩的股份，以奖励并留住AI人才。此前消息显示，2026年上半年，字节跳动营收约1200亿美元，同比增长30%，净利润约200亿美元；近期公司还从银行体系获得约300亿美元贷款，为其历史上规模最大的单笔贷款。

@@@

据量子位报道，DeepSeek宣布正式开放“全家桶”应用API，联网搜索、深度思考搜索、文件上传、链接阅读及语音识别、语音合成等均提供独立接口，支持单独调用、分别计费。语音能力系首次开放；开发者可自由组合，甚至1:1复刻完整DeepSeek App。DeepSeek还开源轻量级聊天前端Demo，支持导入历史对话。此前10月17日开放的Search和Fetch需开发者自行串联工具调用，如今打开联网搜索后，何时搜索、搜什么、读取哪些网页及后续回答可由DeepSeek自动完成；V4.1-Flash已在Messages、Responses和Chat Completions接口下支持相关对话扩展。价格上，语音识别原价0.78元/小时，五折后0.39元，约为OpenAI GPT-Transcribe、GPT-4o mini Transcribe和谷歌云标准服务价格的1/4.6、1/3.1和1/16.5；语音合成每万字符由3元降至1.5元；搜索和网页抓取每1000次成功调用5元，OCR每1000页1.5元。公告称现有对话产品只是较基础的一种形态。

@@@

据Readhub报道，华为常务董事余承东发布视频回顾华为Mate X系列折叠屏手机发展历程，并宣布Mate X8即将推出。视频结尾公开了新机外观，余承东称新机在屏幕、拍照、性能等方面有新突破。流传画面显示，余承东手持一台紫色新机，被认为是Mate X8真机，其采用圆形镜头模组。相关爆料称，Mate X8为常规比例大折叠产品，搭载8英寸广色域京东方新屏与超平整折痕技术，后置50MP、18EV超大底旗舰影像，配备“N代麒麟芯”，并采用大圆Deco搭配宝石环设计。

@@@

Readhub消息，大型无人货运飞机W5000已顺利完成试飞。该飞机由江苏常州研发制造，整机22万个零部件全部实现国产化，最大载重5吨，最远可飞2600公里。截至目前，W5000意向订单已达835架，客户覆盖国内多家物流企业。按计划，该飞机预计于2027年底正式投入商业运营。

@@@

据虎嗅24小时报道，恒瑞医药有12款药品纳入2026年国家医保目录，其中3款为首次纳入。

@@@

据The Verge报道，SpaceX首次使用发射与捕获塔“Mechazilla”的机械臂成功捕获星舰（Starship）飞行器本身。此前该公司已多次以“筷子”方式捕获助推器，但这是首次对星舰飞行器完成这一操作。此次任务中，SpaceX原计划捕获星舰第15次飞行任务的助推器，但助推器中止着陆，随后在墨西哥湾上空爆炸，公司仍在调查原因。报道称，由于未能回收整个运载器，这并非完全成功，但仍被视为星舰项目的里程碑。视频显示，星舰穿云而下、垂直翻转，于美东时间下午约4点20分平稳进入Mechazilla等待的机械臂之间。SpaceX CEO马斯克曾在第三季度财报电话会上表示，这些首飞不保证成功，但下一次飞行成功的可能性大于不成功。

@@@

据Readhub报道，英伟达董事会就外界关注的CEO人选问题作出正式回应。董事会称，目前正处于遴选高管猎头公司的阶段，将启动公司首席执行官职位的招聘工作。董事会明确强调，截至目前尚未与任何潜在候选人进行正式接触，现阶段外界关于任何内部或外部个别候选人的猜测都为时尚早。

@@@

据Readhub消息，意大利对Meta开出8.05亿欧元罚单。

@@@

cnBeta消息，Google为Gemini推出个人财务分析功能，该功能可接入银行账户和信用卡，帮助用户分析个人收支情况。

@@@

据The Verge报道，特斯拉已邀请“精选客户”以29,990美元购买两座、无方向盘的Cybercab用于个人使用，但须同时订阅每月299美元的“Autonomy Subscription”。该车仅在特斯拉Robotaxi服务覆盖的“支持服务区域”销售，初期供应有限；买家还需支付1,000美元不可退还定金，争取12月交付窗口，但不保证交付。取消订阅后，因车辆没有手动驾驶后备方案，Cybercab在公共道路上将完全无法使用。订单条款还禁止商业用途，不能用于Uber、DoorDash，也不能接入特斯拉Robotaxi网络抵消订阅费。按五年持有期计算，强制订阅费增加17,940美元，使税前、充电和保险前的基础成本约达47,600美元，高于全新Model 3或Model Y。特斯拉9月在奥斯汀Robotaxi服务中开始提供Cybercab乘坐；据Robotaxi Tracker，目前278辆Cybercab运营，约占车队40%。特斯拉AI负责人埃卢斯瓦米曾提出，可能在2027年第二季度允许客户车辆加入该网络。

@@@
